title: CmdPal: Shelf (6/n) - Add numbered shortcuts (Alt+#) to list pages
summary: The refreshed current-head review found two code issues requiring correction before approval. The contributor is a collaborator and all reported CI and CLA checks are successful, so no process action is needed.

judgment.rationale: The visual numbered-shortcut cues are intentionally conditional, but their UI Automation accelerator metadata must remain available while the list is shown. In addition, the new UI coverage tests only the simultaneous Alt+number chord and does not cover the latched Alt-then-number path.
evidence: The latest current-head Copilot review published one unresolved comment requesting sequential-key coverage for the latched shortcut path.
The same review identified that ListItemsView returns before refreshing AcceleratorKey values when cue display mode is inactive and clears them when cues are hidden.
PowerToys CI and license/cla checks report success for head cea058b057ccdccdba23701647c3f5b7accf6abc.
judgment.recommended_action: Correct the metadata lifecycle and add a sequential Alt-tap then number UI test, then rerun the focused CmdPal validation and request a fresh review.

proposed_comments.title: Keep numbered accelerator metadata available outside cue-display mode
proposed_comments.body: The Alt+number shortcuts remain active when the visual cues are hidden, but `UpdateNumberedShortcutCues` exits before assigning `AutomationProperties.AcceleratorKey` and hiding cues clears it. Refresh accelerator metadata for realized numbered targets while the view is loaded; limit cue positioning and visual visibility to access-key display mode.

proposed_comments.title: Cover the latched Alt shortcut integration path
proposed_comments.body: The UI test covers a simultaneous Alt+number chord only. Add a separate test that taps and releases Alt, then sends the number key, and verifies invocation or selection so the native hook, access-key controller, and list dispatch path are covered.

actions.label: Address current-head CmdPal shortcut findings
